text:
Mira: Quick readiness check — planning to push Picarus-6B (open weights) into the model catalog tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need: license confirmation, perf profile, quantization guidance, and a canary plan. Who owns what?

Jonah: I ran a couple quick perf passes. Short summary: p50 token gen (seq=64) -> A100: ~48ms, g4dn: ~220ms. Memory-wise looks OK for int8 with batch=1 but seq=2048 hits OOM on smaller instances. I'm generating a perf profile at /mnt/profiles/picarus-6b.json and will attach artifacts to PR #1284. Can do 5% canary if infra signs off.

Leo: Infra note — canary infra available but we saw OOMs at long seqs on g4dn. Need KV-cache tuning + batch scheduling limits. I'll own infra checklist. If we hit OOM in canary we should auto-fallback to the distilled 2.7B variant.

Sasha: Legal check: upstream license is Apache-2.0 but authors added a weights redistribution clause in their repo (not standard). Filed LEG-483 (asked authors for a provider statement). Until we get explicit permission, we should mark public listing as "preview" / restricted.

Mira: Got it. I will mark the model as 'preview' in the catalog and add the runbook link. We also need an int8 vs fp16 QA sweep for generation quality — who can run that? @Jonah?

Jonah: I can run the QA sweep. Quick sanity numbers: on our small eval set (sanity-100) int8 drop is ~0.8% on ROUGE-L and no major coherence regressions. I'll run the full eval overnight and post results in the PR. Artifacts + sample diffs will be in PR #1284.

catalog-bot: ingest started for model 'picarus-6b' (manifest v0.2). CI results: manifest lint OK, metadata warning: 'license_proof' missing.

Mira: Added a placeholder to the manifest with the license ticket link. Manifest: https://go/redwood/catalog/picarus-6b/manifest. Assigning owners: curation=Mira, perf=Jonah, infra=Leo, legal=Sasha.

Sasha: I expect a reply from authors by EOD; if we don't get confirmation, we hold public listing and allow internal preview only.

Jonah: Canary plan (draft):
1) staging smoke test (all smoke checks pass)
2) 5% hosted traffic for 2 hours + perf + error spike watch
3) 20% if stable for 24h
4) ramp to 100% with rollback window and automatic fallback to distilled variant
I'll put this into the PR playbook and add alert thresholds.

Leo: Infra checklist I added to issue INF-902:
```yaml
kv_cache_warmup: true
batch_limits: "seq<=512 for g4dn"
fallback_variant: "picarus-2.7b-distilled"
canary_percent: [5,20]
monitoring: [latency_p50, latency_p95, error_rate, mem_used]
```
If anything spikes we auto-failover to fallback_variant.

Mira: Nice. Two remaining asks: (1) Jonah post the full eval results + diff samples, (2) Sasha update LEG-483 when you hear back so I can flip the public flag.

Jonah: Will post overnight. PR #1284 -> perf/artifacts + playbook.

Sasha: On it — I'll update here when LEG-483 is resolved.

Mira: Great. If all thumbs up tomorrow morning I'll schedule the catalog push. :thumbsup:

Jonah: On it.

Leo: Will monitor canary infra tomorrow.

Sasha: working on the license thread.
